patthana23.23:1.1: na saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana23.23:2.1: na saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.23:3.1: na saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṃ na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha. navitakkattika nakusalattike vitakkattika kusalattikaṃ
